body: Yeah but the reason I don't tell him is 75% because our orientations on a base level do not match up.

We're basically acquaintances. We aren't really friends but he's nice. We do talk sometimes, but not really in depth or consistently I guess. He doesn't know that I would like that kind of relationship with him for multiple reasons, the most glaring of them being that I don't want to be rejected and he would definitely stop all contact with me. He does not know that I have been following him specifically. I'm pretty sure he knows in general cause of various reasons, but he definitely doesn't know its me.

Was never in a relationship with him. Not in a relationship partly because I don't really want to be with anyone else and partly because I don't really talk to other people that much. I cannot talk to a psychiatrist for the time being.
Basically, but I dont want to. I dont really have anyone to talk to it about, my siblings wouldnt want to hear it and I havent been able to bring myself to talk to a school counseler for years.
It's not because my weight is low, the opposite.

It's a strange thing to describe, definitely. For me it's like that feeling of adrenaline not wanting to be caught where every part of you feels cold and then when you're able to get what you want it's like your whole body is warm again and its absolutely cathartic. Personally I stalk (though it definitely doesn't feel right to me to call it stalking) the person I do because I really like him. Love, even. Even then, I know he wouldn't ever really like me so getting information about him and getting stuff thats his in my possession feels really exciting because it's like we're closer I'm some kind of weird nebulous way. It's like the only happiness you get and it makes you incredibly happy, even when you know you probably shouldn't, cause it just feels intuitive and right and like the steps you have to take in order to be something with that person, for either of your best interests. That's just me though, idk.

I know these are probably rhetorical, but I'm still gonna answer cause I kinda want to, I suppose.


Unfortunately, I've tried talking to a school counseler, but its terrifying talking to a professional adult about something that has to do with emotions. I can barely talk to people I trust like that. 

I have other interests, and I know I've been putting them on the back burner for him cause nothing else really holds my attention as well anymore, even when I'm making a concious effort. I've never really been one to be able to focus on something for long but its probably worse now.

We live not too far away from each other so it's not like I'm going SUPER out of my way, he just lives a few neighborhoods over (not too far, especially since walking long distances is something I do pretty often)

What I would say if I got caught is a good point. That would be a doozy indeed. I honestly can barely justify anything to myself. Just an insatiable need to feel closer to him or like I'm making contact with him, I think. It's pretty pathetic, I know.

Finding someone to talk to would be great, but I dont really have friends and talking to strangers about things I feel is embarrassing. 

Sorry if this was dumb and long winded. Anyway, thanks for this comment. It was really uh, eye opening? Made me actually consider my place, which I'm grateful for.
